blocks.text: Singer-actress and former beauty queen Alyssa Muhlach dives into the thrill and hesitation of a budding romance in her latest single, “Maaari Ba.” The indie-pop track captures the familiar feeling of having feelings for someone whose actions are hard to read. Moreover, it explores the unspoken emotions that come with developing feelings for someone new.
